async function run(groups, read) {
 const reason = 'Each update reads the previous write';
 await inOrder(items, read, {reason});
 const options = {reason};
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-javascript
 await inOrder(items, read, options);
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const batch of groups) { await Promise.all(batch.filter(valid).map(read)); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const batch of groups) await Promise.all([...batch.map(read)]);
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const batch of groups) { await Promise.all(batch.flatMap(item => [read(item)])); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const batch of groups) { await Promise.all(Array.from(batch, read)); }
 for (const batch of groups) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(other.filter(valid).map(read));
 }
 for (const item of items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all([read(item), notify(item)]);
 }
 for (const batch of groups) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await inspect(batch);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(batch.filter(valid).map(read));
 }
}
